summary: Iteration 50: retest of the BIBLIA 0.9 final cleanup, covering backend and frontend (web preview at 390/360/800). Nearly everything requested PASSES; one filter bug was found. Data: there are 0 U+FFFD characters in backend/data/commentaries/* and frontend/src/data/offline/commentary/* (742 Rieger entries, 'daß' 2,758×, 'für' 1,093×, no mojibake). Rieger Röm 8,28 shows 'Text: Römer 8,28-39' in the UI. The Kroeker 1Mo 1,1 text has the heading 'Was sind Gottesoffenbarungen?', 'Hebr. 1, 1f.' and 'Erleuchtung', with no 'W a s', no 'Erz leuchtung' and no stray ' j '. Across Kroeker there are 0 ', iff.' and 0 ', if.'. The leftovers are exactly the documented ones: 9 '£' in kroeker-19-88..93, 20-23-29 and 26-6/7, plus '$' in kroeker-4-22-30..4-25-1. The Ansorg mapping is correct and there are 0 duplicate ids. UI: at 360 the tab text no longer touches 'Querverweise'; it is now cut off with an ellipsis ('Studienkom…'). The filter toggle, compare button, and all tradition and source chips are 44px high. When all authors are off, the empty state reads 'Alle Autoren sind im Filter ausgeblendet…' (commentary-empty), and this persists after reload. The regular empty state (1Mo 11,10) is unchanged. Compare is stacked at 390 (w340) and 360 (w310) and side by side at 800 (3×245), with no horizontal overflow. Ansorg Neh 8,1, Dan 11,1, Mt 28,1 and 2Kö 4,1 show the correct -kN ranges. The Way screens behave identically to before: a new check-in was saved, then edited and saved again ('Eintrag aktualisiert'). A prayer with ref Ps 23,1 shows up in review-refs, review-prayers and review-feelings. All 6 review blocks render for week, month and custom, and custom dates work. The /way/topic/sterben-tod page renders all lists and sections, and the missing-topic state works. Deleting an entry works. /living/words and /living/trees load (14 entries, groups, detail, next). Backend: POST and GET /api/status return 404. search with limit=2 returns 2 results with truncated=true; limit=500, limit=0, q>200 chars and q<3 chars all give 422. CORS sends no credentials header. Node tests 42/42 pass; tsc --noEmit is clean; eslint app src is clean (exit 0). There were 0 page errors and 0 console errors. NEW BUG: re-enabling traditions after all of them were turned off is broken (see ui_bugs).

minor.issue: 3 old regression tests fail because their expectations are outdated, not because of an app bug. One expects 7 sources (there are now 13). One expects Genesis 1 to have no commentary (Kroeker now covers it). test_health calls BASE_URL/health, but on the public URL that path goes to the frontend through the ingress, so it gets HTML back. The tests should be updated.

ui_bugs.issue: Steps to reproduce: Röm 8,28 → Filter → turn off all 5 tradition chips (0 von 5) → turn them on again one by one. The first three clicks leave the label at 'Filter · 0 von 5 Autoren' and the chips stay off. The 4th click (Freikirchlich) suddenly jumps to 5/5. The 5th click (Evangelikal) then turns Streitenberger OFF, so the result is 4/5. Root cause: VerseStudy.tsx:89 `const active = pref.length ? pref : all…` keeps the 'none' marker. So `next` is ['none', …ids], pref.includes('none') keeps the count at 0, and the check `next.length === all.length` counts 'none' as an author. Fix: `const active = (pref.length ? pref : all.map(x=>x.id)).filter(id => id !== 'none')`. Re-enabling individual source chips works correctly, because line 103 filters out 'none'.

issues: 'Studienkommentare' no longer overflows or touches its neighbour, but it is cut off with an ellipsis to 'Studienkom…' (text needs 125px, the tab has 95px). adjustsFontSizeToFit only works on native, and even there minimumFontScale 0.8 is not enough (about 0.76 would be needed). Consider a shorter label ('Kommentare') or minimumFontScale 0.7. Reference: frontend/app/(tabs)/bible.tsx:296

rca_of_issue: Tradition filter: the 'none' marker (meaning all authors off) is kept in `active` when traditions are switched back on, so it is carried into `next`. The label then stays at 0 until the length check (which counts 'none') wrongly treats 5 entries as 'all'. Source chips are not affected because they strip 'none'.
